title: Recording production
goal: Production recording: punch, loop record with takes and playlists, monitoring modes, MIDI recording, RF64, meeting the one-hour 16-track criterion.

humanGates.text: Allow a one-hour 16-track recording run with a random kill on the maintainer's machine and device.
humanGates.how: The maintainer starts the run and leaves the machine idle; results are recorded.

features.title: RF64/BWF for takes above 4 GiB
acceptance: Takes switch to RF64 above 4 GiB; repair handles RF64; BWF timestamps carry the timeline position.

features.title: Punch in/out, pre-roll and loop record with takes per pass
acceptance: Punch and loop ranges from the document; one take per loop pass mapped to playlists; seamless loop playback with butler prefetch.

features.title: Monitoring modes and the low-latency monitoring path
acceptance: Off, auto and input monitoring; the loopback offset test passes in every mode.

features.title: MIDI input and MIDI takes
acceptance: midiInbox per device with timestamps converted to sample offsets; MIDI takes become MidiClips in MusicTime; overflow drops and sends all-notes-off.

exit.text: One hour of 16-track recording with a forced kill at a random time loses at most the last second of audio and no edits before the last journal fsync.
exit.how: Long run on the maintainer's machine (human gate).
